entry.author: Horowhenua District Council
entry.summary:
What can actually be recycled, and what still ends up in landfill?

In this episode, we join Kate from Wast-ed with Kate to explore our local transfer station and learn how small actions can make a big difference in reducing waste. We discover what items can be recycled for free, including paint tins, tyres, and other materials that don't need to end up in landfill.

Along the way, we uncover practical tips to help households reduce waste, recycle smarter, and make the most of the services available in our community.
 
Join us as we learn how easy it can be to divert waste from landfill and give everyday items a second life.
